title: 第9章 刘冰冰胸疾第10章 要不要去玩
slug: 分手后我聘上女同学妈妈小司机
content_zh:
一旁的孙雪儿连忙放下手里的勺子，眨着大眼睛说：“我也要去！我还没见过其他地方的赌石市场呢！”
“没问题！”林北爽快应下，抬手招来服务员，直接扫码买了单。
三人快步走出龙凤呈祥餐馆。
陈阳坐上自己的迈巴赫。
林北则带着孙雪儿上了停在不远处的黑色奔驰。
在林北车子的引领下，两辆车一前一后朝着江城高铁站方向驶去。
一路畅通无阻。
两人顺利抵达高铁站，买了最近一班前往莞城的高铁票。
高铁飞速行驶，不到一个小时就抵达了莞城。
三人直奔星耀广场地下一层的赌石市场。
陈阳凭借透视神通，在市场里精准筛选，不到一个小时就收获满满。
等从莞城坐高铁返回江城时，已经将近下午五点。
出了高铁站，陈阳与林北、孙雪儿挥手告别：“今天多谢你们陪我跑一趟，改日我请你们吃饭。”
“客气啥！”林北笑着摆手，“阳哥要是以后还想玩，随时叫我！”
陈阳点点头，转身坐上迈巴赫，直接朝着刘氏集团的方向赶去。
这一下午，他又净赚了三百多万，掏出手机查看银行余额，屏幕上“4900000元”的数字格外醒目。
扣除要还给刘傲菲的十万，他还能剩下四百八十万。
陈阳看着这个数字，嘴角忍不住上扬。
以前他做梦都不敢想，自己能在这么短的时间里赚到这么多钱。
不过，一整天连续多次使用透视神通，耗费了大量真气，让他此刻感到无比疲惫，眼皮都有些沉重。

他强撑着精神。
十几分钟后，迈巴赫稳稳停在刘氏集团大门前的停车位上。
陈阳没有下车，拿出手机给刘傲菲发了条信息：“菲姐，我到公司楼下了。”
发完信息，他靠在座椅上，闭上眼睛开始闭目养神。
指尖无意识地揉着眉心，缓解着身体的疲惫。
没过多久，手机就响了起来，屏幕上显示着“刘傲菲”的名字。
陈阳划开接听键，声音带着一丝不易察觉的沙哑：“菲姐。”
“陈阳，我现在不在公司。”刘傲菲的声音从听筒里传来，背景里似乎还有轻微的脚步声，“你明天早上八点再到我家来接我吧。”
“好的。”陈阳应了一声。
电话很快被挂断，挂电话前，陈阳隐约听到了刘冰冰的声音。
他心里暗自思忖：她们该不会在医院吧？
不知道刘冰冰的检查结果怎么样了？
她的胸口不适应该没什么大问题吧？
既然不用接刘傲菲，陈阳索性把座椅调低，舒舒服服地躺在上面，闭上眼睛。
疲惫感如同潮水般涌来，他很快就进入了梦乡。
另一边。
江城第一人民医院的走廊上。
刘傲菲收起手机，转身看向身旁的刘冰冰，伸手轻轻挽住她的胳膊：“走吧，我们先回去。”
刘冰冰脸色苍白，眼神里满是惶恐和抗拒，脚步有些沉重地跟着母亲往外走，声音带着哭腔：“要我把整个胸切掉，那我宁愿不活了！”
“傻孩子，没那么严重。”刘傲菲心疼地拍了拍她的手背，柔声安慰道，“钟医生不是说了吗，只是做个微创手术就行，不会有事的。”

“可医生也说了，要是我这肿瘤是恶性的，那我的胸就必须全部切除！”刘冰冰停下脚步，眼眶通红，泪水在眼眶里打转，“妈，要是真切掉，那样太难看了……”
“哪有那么多恶性的？肯定是良性的，你别胡思乱想。”刘傲菲轻轻擦掉她眼角的泪水，语气坚定，“妈先带你去抓点中药，咱们先保守治疗看看。”
“实在不行，到时咱们再想其他办法，总会有解决的办法的。”
content_en:
Sun Xueer on the side quickly put down the spoon in her hand, blinked her big eyes and said, "I want to go too! I haven't seen the stone gambling market in other places!"
"No problem!" Lin Bei agreed readily, raised his hand to call the waiter, and directly scanned the QR code to pay the order.
The three of them quickly walked out of Longfeng Chengxiang Restaurant.
Chen Yang got into his Maybach.
Lin Bei took Sun Xueer into the black Mercedes-Benz parked not far away.
Under the guidance of Lin Bei's car, the two cars drove towards Jiangcheng High-speed Railway Station one after the other.
The journey was smooth.
The two arrived at the high-speed rail station smoothly and bought tickets for the latest high-speed rail to Guancheng.
The high-speed train traveled quickly and arrived in Guancheng in less than an hour.
The three of them went straight to the stone betting market on the basement floor of Xingyao Plaza.
Chen Yang relied on his magical powers of clairvoyance to accurately screen the market, and gained a lot in less than an hour.
By the time we took the high-speed train from Guancheng back to Jiangcheng, it was almost five o'clock in the afternoon.
After leaving the high-speed rail station, Chen Yang waved goodbye to Lin Bei and Sun Xueer: "Thank you for accompanying me today. I will treat you to dinner another day."
"Why are you so polite!" Lin Bei smiled and waved his hand, "Brother Yang, if you still want to play in the future, call me anytime!"
Chen Yang nodded, turned around and got into the Maybach, heading straight towards the Liu Group.
This afternoon, he made another net profit of more than 3 million yuan. He took out his mobile phone to check his bank balance. The number "4.9 million yuan" on the screen was particularly eye-catching.
After deducting the 100,000 that had to be paid back to Liu Aofei, he still had 4.8 million left.
Chen Yang looked at this number and couldn't help but raise the corners of his mouth.
He never dreamed before that he could make so much money in such a short period of time.
However, using his clairvoyance power many times throughout the day consumed a lot of energy, making him feel extremely tired at the moment and his eyelids were a little heavy.
He braced himself.
Ten minutes later, the Maybach parked steadily in the parking space in front of the Liu Group's gate.
Chen Yang didn't get out of the car. He took out his mobile phone and sent a message to Liu Aofei: "Sister Fei, I'm downstairs at the company."
After sending the message, he leaned back on his seat, closed his eyes and began to rest.
The fingertips unconsciously rubbed the center of the eyebrows to relieve the fatigue of the body.
Not long after, the phone rang, and the name "Liu Aofei" was displayed on the screen.
Chen Yang opened the answer button and said with an imperceptible hoarseness in his voice: "Sister Fei."
"Chen Yang, I'm not in the company right now." Liu Aofei's voice came from the receiver, and there seemed to be slight footsteps in the background, "You can pick me up at my house at eight o'clock tomorrow morning."
"Okay." Chen Yang responded.
The call was quickly hung up. Before hanging up, Chen Yang vaguely heard Liu Bingbing's voice.
He secretly thought to himself: Could they be in the hospital?
I wonder what happened to Liu Bingbing’s test results?
Her chest discomfort shouldn't be a big problem, right?
Since there was no need to pick up Liu Aofei, Chen Yang simply lowered the seat, lay on it comfortably and closed his eyes.
Fatigue came over him like a tide, and he soon fell asleep.
other side.
In the corridor of Jiangcheng First People's Hospital.
Liu Aofei put away her phone, turned to look at Liu Bingbing beside her, reached out and gently took her arm: "Let's go back first."
Liu Bingbing's face was pale, her eyes were full of fear and resistance, and she followed her mother out with heavy steps. Her voice was crying: "If you want me to cut off the whole chest, then I would rather not live!"
"Silly kid, it's not that serious." Liu Aofei patted the back of her hand distressedly and comforted her softly, "Didn't Dr. Zhong say that it's just a minimally invasive surgery? Everything will be fine."
"But the doctor also said that if my tumor is malignant, then all my breasts must be removed!" Liu Bingbing stopped, her eyes were red and tears were rolling in her eyes, "Mom, if it is really removed, it would be too ugly..."
"How can there be so many vicious people? KenIt must be benign, don't think too much. Liu Aofei gently wiped away the tears from the corner of her eyes and said firmly, "Mom will take you to get some Chinese medicine first. Let's give conservative treatment first." "
“If it really doesn’t work, then we will think of other ways and there will always be a solution. "
